result.title: Calibrating Multimodal Test-Time Adaptation under Reliability and Availability Modality Shifts
result.summary: Multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) enables pretrained multimodal models to accommodate distribution shifts during inference using only unlabeled test data, without recourse to the original training data. Compared with unimodal adaptation, multimodal adaptation is further complicated by the coexistence and interaction of multiple representation perspectives. This complexity is particularly pronounced under modality reliability shifts, which preserve modality availability but degrade information quality, and modality availability shifts, which render the corresponding modality entirely inaccessible. Category-conditional Gaussian modeling offers a natural starting point for handling such distributional variations, having proven effective in unimodal test-time adaptation for characterizing representation distributions, yet its extension to multimodal settings requires a more elaborate formulation. To this end, we propose Adaptive Probabilistic Gaussian Calibration (AdaPGC), which extends category-conditional Gaussian modeling across modality-specific and multimodal fusion representations for probabilistic calibration under multimodal distribution shifts. AdaPGC continuously updates category-conditional Gaussian models over modality-specific and fusion representations, using the resulting probabilistic predictions to calibrate source model predictions and guide reliability based rectification, while exploiting their joint distributions to recover unavailable fusion representations. Extensive experiments under diverse modality corruption and missingness conditions demonstrate that AdaPGC effectively improves robustness under both modality reliability and availability shifts. Our source code will be released at https://github.com/XuJinglinn/AdaPGC-plus.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AdaPGC，将类别条件高斯建模从单模态扩展到模态特定表示与多模态融合表示，在测试期持续更新高斯模型，用其概率预测校准源模型输出并做可靠性导向修正，同时用联合分布恢复不可用的融合表示，以应对模态可靠性下降与模态缺失两类偏移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按可靠性修正预测、并借联合分布补全缺失融合表示的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据质量下降、视觉旁路与信息坍缩的检测和补偿提供线索；但方法是 TTA 校准而非推理期 latent 状态生成，迁移价值需核查。
